content.title: About
content.content: Fudgesicle Light is a frozen dessert made from low‑fat milk, with reduced sugar and a thin chocolate coating. It offers a smooth, creamy flavor with subtle cocoa and fruit notes, and a texture reminiscent of classic fudge.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Fudgesicle Light was first launched in 2021 as part of the "light" line for calorie‑conscious consumers.
The recipe uses real cocoa butter instead of vegetable oil substitutes.
It contains 30 % less sugar than the regular Fudgesicle.
Each serving is coated with a thin chocolate glaze made without glucose syrup.
The product is certified gluten‑free and contains no artificial colorings.

items.title: Low in fat
items.content: Reduced saturated fat helps maintain healthy cholesterol levels.

items.title: Reduced calories
items.content: Approximately 120 kcal per serving, making it suitable for diet plans.

items.title: Source of calcium
items.content: The dairy base provides calcium important for bones and teeth.

items.title: B‑vitamins
items.content: Milk contributes riboflavin (B2) and B12, supporting energy metabolism.

items.title: Antioxidants from cocoa
items.content: Cocoa butter adds flavonoids that may protect cells from oxidative stress.

items.title: Lactose intolerance
items.content: Contains milk, so those with lactose intolerance should choose lactose‑free alternatives.

items.title: Milk protein allergy
items.content: Allergy to casein can trigger reactions even at small amounts.

items.title: Sugar content
items.content: Although reduced, the product still contains added sugars, which may be a concern for diabetics.

items.title: Cold dessert
items.content: Consuming directly from the freezer may cause discomfort for people with sensitive teeth.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Fudgesicle Light is convenient to eat straight from the package. It can be diced and added to fruit salads, used as a cold topping for yogurt, or blended into a quick smoothie with berries.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep the frozen dessert in a freezer at –18 °C (0 °F) or lower. After removal from the wrapper, it is best consumed within 30 minutes to preserve texture. Do not thaw and refreeze.
